status: Exploratory secondary decision metrics, not new independent confirmation or model-selection targets

definitions.pairwise: Fraction of non-tied observed solvent pairs correctly ordered; prediction ties receive half credit
definitions.top_rank: Observed within-panel normalized midrank of top predicted solvent, 0 worst to 1 best
definitions.best_hit: Fraction selecting an observed best solvent. Uniform expected score across exactly tied top predictions.

weighting: Average panels within sequence, then sequences; paired bootstrap on saved uncertainty groups, conditional on fits
